title: Instrument golden signals and token-level latency SLIs; dashboards for multi-region failover and circuit-breakers
creator: Marco Chen
description:
Goal: Define canonical golden signals for the inference platform and implement token-level latency SLIs with low-cost, production-safe instrumentation. Build SRE and Console dashboards to track multi-region failover health, circuit-breaker state, and load-shedding rates.

Background: We currently have request-level latency and basic error counts but lack per-token latency SLIs and visibility into circuit-breaker behavior during overload and multi-region failovers. This makes it hard to correlate user-facing latency regressions with runtime batching, KV cache misses, or region failover activity.

Acceptance criteria:
- Runtime emits token-level latency metrics (or low-cost estimate) with bounded cardinality and clear labels (model, route, region, deployment).
- Define SLIs: token_latency.p50/p90/p95/p99 (ms per token) computed for production traffic windows, with SLO targets and error budget definitions documented.
- Dashboards: global Golden Signals dashboard, per-region failover dashboard, circuit-breaker & load-shedding dashboard. Dashboards integrate with Console and include runbooks/links.
- Alerts: alert rules for SLO burn rate, circuit-breaker trip rate spike, shed_rate > X%, and failover success < 99.5% over 5m.
- Rollout: canary in dedicated-only region, monitor costs, enable sampling, then platform-wide rollout.

Design notes and trade-offs:
- Token-level instrumentation approaches considered:
  1) Emit per-token events: very high cardinality and cost; unacceptable at full traffic.
  2) Emit per-response aggregated metrics: calculate avg_token_latency = (response_end - request_start) / token_count and emit histogram per response. Lower cardinality but hides per-token jitter.
  3) Hybrid sampling: emit histograms for every response but only with token_count and computed per-token latency; additionally sample 1/100 responses with per-token trace events for debugging.
Decision: go with approach (2) + targeted sampling (3) for debug traces. Use response-level histogram with buckets tuned to token-latency distribution (1ms, 2ms, 5ms, 10ms, 25ms, 50ms, 100ms, 250ms).

Labeling and cardinality control:
- Required labels: model, route, region, deployment_id, quant_profile (coarse: fp16/int8/quantized).
- Avoid per-customer or prompt-hash labels to prevent explosion. For customer-level SLOs, compute derived aggregates in the metrics pipeline.
- Sampling rules: 1% of requests from free tier; 10% of requests from enterprise tier; 100% for canary region.

Measurement windows and SLI math:
- Primary SLI: token_latency.p95 over a rolling 5m window, aggregated hourly for SLO evaluation.
- Error budget: 99.7% of tokens under 25ms p95 per hour (example target; PM to finalize).
- Complementary SLIs: request_error_rate (5xx generation errors), request_throughput (rps), saturation.gpu_utilization (p95), shed_rate (percent of requests shed by runtime).

Dashboard layout (high level):
- Golden Signals (SRE): top row SLI gauges (token_latency.p50/p90/p95/p99), error_budget_remaining, throughput. Middle rows: histograms by model and region, top offending routes. Bottom: correlated metrics (cache_miss_rate, batch_size_avg, kv_cache_evictions).
- Circuit Breaker & Load-shedding: real-time panel for circuit-breaker state per deployment, trips/min, avg_open_duration, shed_rate by reason (cpu_pressure/memory_pressure/overloaded_model). Include links to runbook.
- Multi-region Failover: failover_success_rate (per-region pairs), cross-region latency delta, active_traffic_distribution, last_failover_timestamp and reason.

Runbook links and playbooks will be embedded in dashboards with direct links to: PagerDuty runbook, incident checklist, and postmortem template.

Runtime: implement sampling path for per-token traces (1/100 default, configurable)
Metrics pipeline: add aggregation jobs for token SLI rollups (5m windows + hourly summaries)
Dashboards: build 'Golden Signals - Inference' Grafana dashboard and import to Console (SRE + PM views)
Alerts: author alert rules and add to AlertManager with on-call escalation paths
Canary rollout: deploy instrumentation in canary cluster, monitor cost delta and SLI behavior for 48h
Docs: PRD + acceptance criteria + release notes for runtime-1.18

2024-10-12 Aisha Patel: Updated runtime PR with sampling configuration and lower-cardinality labels. Added e2e test that validates histogram buckets are emitted for sampled responses.
2024-10-15 SRE review (Eliot Morris): Approve dashboard layout but request explicit panels for cache_miss_rate and batch_size_avg correlation. Added as follow-up task.
